payload.title: PaMoDaCo: Working with measurements and model output
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook explores the integration of sparse measurement data with model outputs to assess the accuracy of model simulations of neodymium isotopes. It utilizes data from Poppelmeier et al., 2021, and the C-iTRACE simulation to analyze spatial distributions of $\varepsilon$Nd. The notebook demonstrates loading and processing of datasets, plotting spatial distributions, and examining the uniqueness of measured values in the water column. The analysis provides insights into the local watermass geometry and the reliability of model predictions.
goals: Integrate measurement data with model outputs.
Assess model accuracy in simulating neodymium isotopes.
Examine the uniqueness of measured values in the water column.
